[A16] Report SELinux disabled to Android userspace
target_commits.body:
Source: A13 external/selinux d42add96533decac77101c314e5abceae20070d7.

Purpose: preserve the App Player compatibility contract where Android callers skip SELinux context and restorecon paths while init keeps the kernel in permissive mode.

Adaptation: retain upstream host libselinux detection and return disabled only for Android builds, limiting the behavior change to the guest product.

Necessity: AOSP16 omitted this authority patch; installd, cmd, restorecon, and libselinux Android helpers otherwise take a different path from A13.

Performance: avoids restorecon/context work and therefore cannot add boot cost.

Security: intentionally suppresses Android userspace SELinux handling; this is a broad defense-in-depth reduction inherited from A13 and requires runtime boot validation.

Validation: target libselinux, init, and installd build passed; host libselinux_test passed 12/12 for 32/64; target 32/64 disassembly independently confirms a zero return.

target_commits.subject: [A16] Keep SELinux userspace enabled for APEX labeling
target_commits.body:
Source: restore the Android 16 upstream libselinux behavior from parent 085c131a; A13 d42add96 remains the authority record but its userspace-disabled mechanism is not API-compatible with Android 16 CAPEX activation.

Purpose: let restorecon and other Android userspace callers observe the mounted SELinux filesystem so /data/apex/decompressed retains staging_data_file labels and the tethering APEX can override the netbpfload fallback service.

Necessity: boot evidence at Root e2b0cf64 reproduced reboot,netbpfload-missing with is_selinux_enabled() forced to zero, matching the documented cont.21 regression. Kernel permissive mode remains the App Player enforcement policy.

Performance: restores normal Android 16 labeling work during boot; this has bounded first-boot I/O cost and prevents the fatal APEX retry/reboot path.

Security: improves userspace labeling consistency without enabling kernel enforcement.

[A16] Restore App Player network presentation
target_commits.body:
Sources: A13 packages/modules/Connectivity eb7ce30646385250ec05e673aafedee4c33363b5, 6bbe6af294c67c9af56f4d3e7c8a4553f2b6483f, and the network-agent portion of d86f187aea77c164213462d377884fa3473d1e47.

Purpose: present the emulated Ethernet link as Wi-Fi by default, allow BstFilterAppsService to request true Ethernet presentation, and report the Wi-Fi legacy network type when bst.config.modify_network is enabled.

Adaptation: A16 parses transport configuration in EthernetConfigParser and creates NetworkAgentConfig in a refactored factory. Query the already-started BlueStacks binder service at config parse time and expose the property check through Dependencies for deterministic tests.

Necessity: the previous A16 merge contained only the static-IP part of d86f187; transport and legacy-type behavior was absent.

Performance: adds one binder query per configured Ethernet interface during startup and one property read on provisioning; neither is a packet-path cost.

Security: changes network identity visible to apps and policy code by design; no new privilege or external input surface is introduced.

Validation: FrameworksNetTests build completed 2341/2341; ConnectivityUnitTestsLib compiled and contains dedicated Wi-Fi transport and legacy-type tests; service jar readback contains bstfilterapps, isEtherNetType, and bst.config.modify_network.

target_commits.subject: [A16] Unroll DSCP policy matching
target_commits.body:
Source: A13 packages/modules/Connectivity 56a3aff5be6304f88eba2fcdee09cde8ad42fd5c.

Purpose: preserve the App Player optimization that fully unrolls the bounded DSCP policy scan, reducing eBPF verifier work when the policy program is loaded.

Adaptation: apply the pragma to A16 bpf/progs/dscpPolicy.c, where the A13 bpf_progs/dscp_policy.c loop moved and was otherwise refactored.

Necessity: the A16 merge did not contain this directive, so the A13 BPF loading optimization was absent.

Performance: trades a larger generated BPF instruction stream for lower verifier loop-analysis cost; the per-packet matching semantics and MAX_POLICIES bound are unchanged.

Security: no policy acceptance or packet mutation semantics change.

Validation: dscpPolicy.o compiled with -Werror; APEX and system copies are byte-identical with SHA-256 6796c9c678c6134130bf8e8cd549081783c4264dd2fd687f5541b8e7f8ff74f2.

target_commits.subject: [A16] Restore China captive portal policy
target_commits.body:
Sources: A13 packages/modules/Connectivity 33b855c9022604cec5944afbbffad06ff85eb50e and its API-fix follow-up f082bfff816777d3b0133e249038aac079dcbd43.

Purpose: default captive portal handling to IGNORE for the nxt_cn OEM while preserving the user-configured global mode and the A16 Wear Bluetooth exception.

Adaptation: retain the A16 getCaptivePortalMode(NetworkAgentInfo) contract and ConnectivitySettingsManager constants, then apply the A13 OEM-specific default only after the Wear special case.

Necessity: the previous A16 merge lacked the nxt_cn default, changing China game network behavior from the A13 authority.

Performance: adds two cached system-property reads only when captive portal mode is evaluated; no packet-path work is added.

Security: nxt_cn intentionally bypasses captive portal prompting by default, which can hide untrusted portal interception; an explicit global setting still overrides the default.

[A16] Stop the PRNG seeder early-init service
target_commits.body:
Source: A13 system/security ef05d6c885bc1a74ff8bf37d322b0b9c1d86d31a.

Purpose: preserve the App Player boot policy for guests without a hardware random device by omitting prng_seeder.rc from the installed service set.

Adaptation: A16 moved init_rc into prng_seeder_defaults; disable that single property while retaining the binary, Microdroid variant, source, and tests.

Necessity: both AOSP16 and the current Android-16 tree still registered the early-init service, so the A13 boot-time customization was missing.

Performance: removes a daemon that can wait on unavailable entropy during early boot; no steady-state cost is added.

Security: removes this daemon reseed path; the decision is inherited from A13 and assumes the VM kernel CRNG has an independent entropy source. Boot and entropy readback remain required.

Validation: prng_seeder and 32/64 test binaries built; independent install-tree readback confirms the binary remains and system/etc/init/prng_seeder.rc is absent.
